personal.preferred_title: Senior Cloud Capacity & Efficiency Engineer | AWS/GCP Capacity Planning | Python/SQL Forecasting

summary: Senior Cloud Capacity & Efficiency Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise IT experience across capacity planning, infrastructure telemetry, data engineering, performance engineering, and cloud-scale analytics. Strong fit for cloud capacity and efficiency work through hands-on Python, SQL, PySpark, AWS, forecasting, telemetry pipelines, utilization analysis, rightsizing recommendations, and stakeholder-facing capacity reporting. Built forecasting and attribution-style data workflows using infrastructure telemetry from thousands of endpoints, supporting demand planning, bottleneck prediction, consolidation opportunities, cost-aware infrastructure decisions, and executive technology planning. AWS hands-on experience with transferable GCP cloud capacity concepts.

experience.title: Senior Capacity Planning & Cloud Data Engineer
bullets: Owned capacity-planning analytics for large-scale enterprise infrastructure by ingesting P95 telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints into automated Python/Pandas and SQL workflows for demand planning, risk detection, and executive reporting.

Developed forecasting models using Prophet and scikit-learn to predict CPU, memory, and infrastructure capacity bottlenecks up to 6 months ahead with 90%+ accuracy, improving provisioning lead time and reducing reactive capacity decisions.

Built AWS-based capacity analytics pipelines using S3 landing zones, AWS Glue ETL, Amazon Redshift workloads, and historical telemetry models to support cloud-scale utilization, trend, and forecasting analysis.

Migrated heavy capacity forecasting workloads from on-prem Oracle processing to Amazon Redshift, enabling more scalable parallel analysis for infrastructure demand, utilization trends, and long-range planning.

Identified underutilized infrastructure through data mining across thousands of endpoints, supporting rightsizing, hardware consolidation, spend reduction opportunities, and improved allocation of compute capacity.

Produced capacity and efficiency reporting for senior technology stakeholders, translating telemetry, utilization, and forecast outputs into infrastructure planning recommendations and operational decision support.

Integrated monitoring and capacity feeds from BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily, and AppDynamics into unified reporting layers used for bottleneck detection, seasonal trend analysis, and platform capacity reviews.
Designed optimized Oracle schemas and historical retention structures for long-term telemetry history, seasonal workload patterns, capacity risk analysis, and forecast model training.
Containerized Python ETL jobs on EC2/ECS to support repeatable on-demand processing for recurring capacity forecasting, infrastructure analytics, and reporting pipelines.

Partnered with application, infrastructure, and operations teams to align capacity forecasts with platform demand, growth assumptions, remediation planning, and infrastructure optimization priorities.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems, translating real-user and synthetic telemetry into performance and optimization recommendations.
Led the FAST project, data-mining user performance metrics to identify opportunities adopted by engineering teams for critical revenue-generating digital systems.
Implemented End-User Monitoring and end-to-end transaction tracing across web and mobile applications, improving operational visibility into demand, latency, and user experience patterns.
Participated in AWS cloud migration planning by providing APM readiness assessment, monitoring requirements, and performance engineering input for cloud transition decisions.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Served as CA APM SME for an enterprise environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents, supporting large-scale telemetry collection and performance analysis.
Designed dashboards, alert thresholds, SLA monitoring, and management modules that became standard patterns across client environments.
Built Perl and Korn Shell data-extraction scripts to automate performance reporting and replace manual weekly exports.
Provided sizing recommendations, golden-image deployment guidance, and onboarding support for new monitored applications across J2EE/WebLogic environments.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a high-throughput shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster while maintaining high transaction capacity and sub-second query latency.
Optimized C++/OCCI transaction processing and database access patterns, reducing physical hardware footprint by 95% while preserving performance requirements.
Built validation and testing frameworks to verify migration correctness across millions of transaction records during phased cutover.
